title: 9 Best Software to Pay Property Owners and Vendors
summary: Compare 9 ways vacation rental managers pay owners and vendors, from Topkey and Guesty Accounting to BILL, Melio, Ramp Bill Pay and Tipalti.
body_markdown:
*Updated November 2026*


It's payout day.


Owner statements are approved, and owners are waiting on their money. Meanwhile, a stack of bills from cleaners, plumbers, landscapers and suppliers is waiting too. At many vacation rental companies, that's two separate payment runs in two separate places. Often it's one payment at a time in a bank portal.


That's slow, and it's where mistakes happen. A payment coded to the wrong property throws off an owner statement. A missed bill sours a vendor you rely on. An owner paid late starts wondering about other managers.


This guide compares nine ways vacation rental managers pay owners and vendors. Topkey leads the list, and the rest are in reading order.


## The 9 Options at a Glance


Option Built to pay Best for


Topkey Owners and vendors Paying both from one place, coded by property


Guesty Accounting Owners and vendors Guesty users


Hospitable Owners Hospitable users paying owners automatically


VRPlatform Owners Managers running books on an STR ledger


BILL Vendors AP teams with high bill volume


Melio Vendors Small teams that want simple vendor payments


Ramp Bill Pay Vendors Ramp customers paying vendors in the same platform


Tipalti Vendors Global, multi-entity finance teams


Bank portal and paper checks Anyone Very low payment volume


## How We Picked and Checked These Tools


Each option pays property owners, vendors or both, and is used by property managers or by finance teams broadly. For every one, we looked at who it's built to pay, payment methods, approvals, property coding and how payments sync to your books.


We checked those features on each vendor's own website on November 24 and 25, 2026. We didn't compare fees or transfer speeds, because both change often.


## What to Look for in Payment Software


The biggest time saver is paying owners and vendors in one run. Two systems means two logins, two approval chains and two sets of records to reconcile.


Every payment should carry a property and a GL code. If it doesn't, someone recodes it later, and that's where owner statements go wrong.


You also want approvals and an audit trail, so you can see who created, approved and sent each payment. And payments should sync back to your PMS and accounting software, so nobody types them in a second time.


## Built for Vacation Rentals


### 1. Topkey


Topkey is the AI-powered financial operating system built specifically for vacation rental managers. It pays property owners and vendors from one place, with every payment coded to a property and synced to your PMS and accounting software.


**How it handles owner and vendor payments.**[Owner payouts](https://topkey.io/features/owner-payouts) go through draft, approve and pay, with an audit trail of who did each step. Each payout is coded by GL and property, synced to your books and PMS, and every owner can be paid in bulk from one list.


[Topkey bill pay](https://topkey.io/bill-pay) takes bills by email or from connected systems, reads the vendor, category and property, and flags duplicates and mismatched payments. Bills can be split across properties or tied to work orders, then paid in bulk by ACH or check, with W-9s and banking details kept on file.


[Approval workflows](https://topkey.io/features/approval-workflows) route bills by amount, property, vendor or entity, so a $5,000 roof repair and a $40 supply run don't follow the same path. And since owner statements live in the same system, each owner's payout comes from a reviewed statement, not a number typed into a bank portal.


**Where Topkey isn't the right fit.** If you only manage properties you own, there are no owners to pay, and a general bill pay tool may cover your vendors.


**Best for:** anyone running owner payouts and vendor bills as two separate jobs. The more doors you manage, the more the coding and approvals matter.


[Visit Topkey](https://topkey.io/bill-pay)


## Owner Payouts Inside a PMS or STR Ledger


These tools pay owners from the same place your statements live. That's convenient, but it ties your payments to that system.


### 2. Guesty Accounting


Guesty Accounting lives inside the Guesty PMS, so payments sit right next to your reservations.


**What it does well.** Guesty pays owners and vendors with native ACH transfers and NACHA file generation, all managed in Guesty. Payments connect to the same trust accounting and owner statements, which makes reconciliation easier.


**Where it falls short.** It's only available to Guesty users. If you ever change PMS, your whole payment setup has to be rebuilt somewhere else.


**Best for:** Guesty users who want owner and vendor payments in their PMS.


[Visit Guesty Accounting](https://www.guesty.com/features/accounting/)


### 3. Hospitable


Hospitable is a vacation rental platform for hosts and property managers.


**What it does well.** Hospitable generates monthly owner statements and pays owners their share straight to their bank accounts, including splitting payouts across multiple accounts. Owner Payments lets you invoice owners who owe you money and collect it through the owner portal.


**Where it falls short.** Its payment tools are built around owners, not vendor bills. Paying cleaners, contractors and suppliers still happens somewhere else.


**Best for:** Hospitable users who want owner payouts to run automatically.


[Visit Hospitable](https://hospitable.com/features/owner-payouts)


### 4. VRPlatform (VRTrust)


VRTrust is VRPlatform's short-term rental accounting software.


**What it does well.** Owners can be paid with one-click ACH straight from VRTrust's trust ledger. Because payouts come from the same ledger as statements, owner balances stay in step.


**Where it falls short.** You have to run your books on VRTrust to use it. Vendor bill capture and approvals aren't what it's built around.


**Best for:** managers who already run their books on VRTrust.


[Visit VRPlatform](https://vrplatform.app/)


## General Bill Pay


General bill pay tools are excellent at paying vendors, for any kind of business. That means property coding and owner payouts are up to you to set up.


### 5. BILL


BILL is accounts payable software that BILL says more than 500,000 businesses use.


**What it does well.** BILL captures invoices with AI, routes approvals by your policies, and pays by ACH, check, card, virtual card or international wire. Its network includes more than 4.7 million members, and it handles multiple entities from one parent account.


**Where it falls short.** BILL doesn't know your properties or owners. Every bill needs a property code added by hand, and owner payouts aren't what it's designed for.


**Best for:** AP teams with high vendor bill volume.


[Visit BILL](https://www.bill.com/product/accounts-payable)


### 6. Melio


Melio is bill pay built for small businesses.


**What it does well.** You can pay by bank transfer or card, and the vendor gets paid how they choose: ACH, check, wire or a virtual card. Vendors don't need a Melio account. It syncs with QuickBooks Online, and you can approve bills from the mobile app.


**Where it falls short.** It's built for small businesses in general, with no property or owner tracking. As volume grows, the coding work stays manual.


**Best for:** small teams that want a simple way to pay vendors.


[Visit Melio](https://melio.com/)


### 7. Ramp Bill Pay


Ramp Bill Pay is accounts payable inside Ramp's finance platform.


**What it does well.** It reads invoices with OCR, routes approvals by amount, department or vendor, and pays by ACH, card, check or wire, domestic or international. You can pay bills in batches, store W-9s and export 1099 data, and it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero, Sage Intacct and NetSuite.


**Where it falls short.** It's built for every kind of business, so property tags and owner charges aren't part of it. Many vacation rental teams pair Ramp with Topkey. The[Ramp + Topkey integration](https://topkey.io/blog/how-vacation-rental-property-managers-automate-financial-operations-with-ramp-topkey) lets you create virtual Ramp cards inside Topkey and carries the property details into your PMS and accounting.


**Best for:** Ramp customers who want vendor payments in the same platform as their cards.


[Visit Ramp Bill Pay](https://ramp.com/accounts-payable)


### 8. Tipalti


Tipalti is payables and mass payment software for global finance teams.


**What it does well.** Suppliers onboard themselves, and Tipalti collects and checks their tax IDs. It pays in more than 200 countries and 120 currencies, and manages payables across many entities.


**Where it falls short.** Most vacation rental teams pay domestic vendors and owners, so they won't use much of Tipalti's global depth. Property coding and owner payouts aren't built in.


**Best for:** global, multi-entity companies paying many suppliers.


[Visit Tipalti](https://tipalti.com/)


## The Manual Workaround


### 9. Bank Portal and Paper Checks


Many teams still pay from their bank's website and a checkbook.


**What it does well.** It needs no new software, and your bank already offers ACH and bill pay.


**Where it falls short.** Every payment is keyed in one at a time, and nothing syncs back. Someone codes each payment to a property later, and the audit trail is whatever your team remembers.


**Best for:** very low payment volume.


## The Bottom Line


General bill pay tools are great at vendors. PMS tools are good at owners. Most vacation rental teams need both, coded to the right property and synced to their books. Topkey is #1 because it pays owners and vendors from one place, with every payment coded by property and GL.


Only need the vendor side? See our[9 best bill pay software for short-term rental property managers](https://topkey.io/blog/9-best-bill-pay-software-for-short-term-rental-property-managers) .


[See how Topkey pays owners and vendors](https://topkey.io/bill-pay)


## Frequently Asked Questions


### How do vacation rental managers pay property owners?


Most pay owners by ACH after monthly statements are approved. Software like Topkey, Guesty Accounting, Hospitable and VRPlatform pays owners from the same place statements are built, so payouts match the statement.


### What is a NACHA file?


A NACHA file is the standard file format for sending a batch of ACH payments to your bank. Tools like Guesty Accounting generate one so you can pay many owners or vendors at once.


### Can I pay owners and vendors from the same software?


Yes. Topkey pays owners and vendors from one place, with every payment coded by property and GL. Guesty Accounting also pays both for Guesty users.


### Should owner payouts come from the trust account?


Owner funds are usually held in a trust account, so owner payouts usually come from it. Rules vary by state, so confirm your setup with your accountant.


### What's the safest way to collect owners' and vendors' bank details?


Avoid email. Use a secure form or the vendor management tools in your payment software, which store banking details and W-9s in one protected place.


### Does bill pay software sync with QuickBooks?


Most does. BILL, Melio and Ramp sync with QuickBooks, and Topkey syncs payments to QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, Sage Intacct and NetSuite, plus your PMS.
